package syntax // import "ubunatic.com/loom/syntax"

Package syntax is experimental; its API may change between releases. See
docs/APIStability.md for the package stability policy.

Package syntax defines UI-neutral syntax highlighting interfaces and types.

FUNCTIONS

func ByteToRune(source []byte, offset int) int
    ByteToRune converts a byte offset to a rune offset, clamping to source
    bounds.

func RuneToByte(source []byte, offset int) int
    RuneToByte converts a rune offset to a byte offset, clamping to source
    bounds.

func RuneToDisplayCol(source []byte, offset int) int
    RuneToDisplayCol returns the terminal-cell column at a rune offset.


TYPES

type Capture string
    Capture names a standard syntax token class.

const (
	CaptureKeyword            Capture = "keyword"
	CaptureFunction           Capture = "function"
	CaptureFunctionCall       Capture = "function.call"
	CaptureType               Capture = "type"
	CaptureString             Capture = "string"
	CaptureComment            Capture = "comment"
	CaptureNumber             Capture = "number"
	CaptureOperator           Capture = "operator"
	CapturePunctuation        Capture = "punctuation"
	CapturePunctuationBracket Capture = "punctuation.bracket"
)
type Edit struct {
	StartByte, OldEndByte, NewEndByte    int
	StartPoint, OldEndPoint, NewEndPoint Point
}
    Edit describes a byte-range replacement and its source positions.

type Engine interface {
	Language() string
	NotifyEdit(edit Edit)
	Parse(source []byte) error
	HighlightLine(line int) []Span
	HighlightViewport(startLine, endLine int) map[int][]Span
}
    Engine parses source and returns capture spans for lines or viewports.

type LexicalEngine struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    LexicalEngine provides lightweight standard-library tokenization.

func NewLexicalEngine(language string) *LexicalEngine
    NewLexicalEngine creates a lexer for go, markdown, json, or yaml.

func (e *LexicalEngine) Breadcrumb(line, col int) []string
    Breadcrumb returns the scope hierarchy at the given zero-based line and
    column.

func (e *LexicalEngine) Folds() [][2]int
    Folds returns all foldable range pairs [startLine, endLine] (0-based,
    inclusive).

func (e *LexicalEngine) HighlightLine(line int) []Span

func (e *LexicalEngine) HighlightViewport(startLine, endLine int) map[int][]Span

func (e *LexicalEngine) Language() string

func (e *LexicalEngine) NotifyEdit(Edit)

func (e *LexicalEngine) Parse(source []byte) error

func (e *LexicalEngine) Symbols() []Symbol
    Symbols returns all symbols recognized in the source.

type Navigator interface {
	OutlineProvider
	Symbols() []Symbol
	Breadcrumb(line, col int) []string
	Folds() [][2]int
}
    Navigator provides structural navigation, breadcrumbs, and fold ranges.

type NullEngine struct{}
    NullEngine is a no-op syntax provider.

func (NullEngine) Breadcrumb(int, int) []string

func (NullEngine) Folds() [][2]int

func (NullEngine) HighlightLine(int) []Span

func (NullEngine) HighlightViewport(int, int) map[int][]Span

func (NullEngine) Language() string

func (NullEngine) NotifyEdit(Edit)

func (NullEngine) Parse([]byte) error

func (NullEngine) Symbols() []Symbol

type OutlineProvider interface {
	Symbols() []Symbol
	Breadcrumb(line, col int) []string
	Folds() [][2]int
}
    OutlineProvider supplies document symbols, breadcrumbs, and fold ranges.

type Point struct{ Row, Column int }
    Point is a zero-based source position. Column is measured in bytes.

type Span struct {
	Line               int
	StartByte, EndByte int
	StartRune, EndRune int
	Capture            string
}
    Span identifies a captured token. Line is zero-based; byte and rune offsets
    are zero-based offsets in the complete parsed document (not line-local).
    Start offsets are inclusive and end offsets are exclusive. Byte offsets
    always land on UTF-8 boundaries.

type StyleResolver map[string]string
    StyleResolver maps standard captures to ANSI SGR styles. Values are SGR
    parameter strings, suitable for wrapping text in ESC[<value>m ... ESC[0m.
    Both 16-color and 256-color terminals understand these standard sequences.

func DefaultStyleResolver() StyleResolver
    DefaultStyleResolver returns conventional colors for standard captures.

func (r StyleResolver) Resolve(capture string) string
    Resolve returns an SGR style, or empty when the capture is unknown.

type Symbol struct {
	Name    string
	Kind    string
	Line    int // 0-based start line
	Column  int // 0-based start column
	EndLine int // 0-based end line
}
    Symbol identifies a recognized code entity (function, method, type, heading,
    key, etc.).

type ThemeMap map[string]string
    ThemeMap maps capture names to UI-owned theme identifiers. Values are
    intentionally strings so this package does not depend on Loom's UI types.

func DefaultThemeMap() ThemeMap
    DefaultThemeMap provides conventional theme keys for standard captures.

func (m ThemeMap) Resolve(capture string) string
    Resolve returns the theme identifier for capture, or the empty string.
